counting_rules: An occurrence is one warning-emitting line selected by the mechanical extractor, plus each apksigner warning captured per ABI APK.
Repeated lines across setup invocations, ABIs, platforms, direct-head and PR-merge runs remain separate occurrences.
Cancelled temp-job logs are partial and are counted only to preserve their emitted warnings; they are not passing validation evidence.
The direct-head and PR-merge formal runs exercise the same source tree. Warning occurrence totals are provenance counts and must not be interpreted as independent defect or test counts.
limits: Classification identifies the emitting path with the stated confidence; it does not exempt system, action, plugin, or dependency warnings from follow-up.
Successful jobs and APK verification do not make these warnings disappear.
No source or workflow fix is made by this audit.
